priority_items.title: DEFA signed at 28th AEC Council in Manila; primary text unpublished
priority_items.summary: FACT: AEC Council ministers signed the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement on Saturday 14 Nov (Manila Times, JPNN/Airlangga, Rappler). Talks launched Sep 2023, concluded May 2026. PNA 09:27 GMT+8 still described signing as expected. Airlangga: accelerate an implementation plan vs AEC Strategic Plan 2026–2030. ADB pledges up to US$5bn by 2030 to operationalise DEFA. EIF/ratification unpublished. Do not use Manila Times $2 billion by 2023 figure.

priority_items.title: 49th ASEAN Summit eve: AMM Saturday, leaders 15–17 Nov, SGP 2027 chair; not emergency AMM
priority_items.summary: FACT: 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits 15–17 Nov in Manila under PHL chair; ministerial track Saturday 14 Nov. PNA names Trump, Carney, Albanese, Modi, Takaichi, Lee Jae-myung, Lula among expected partners; CNA names Li Qiang; APEC Shenzhen 18 Nov. Rappler: PHL hands gavel to SGP for 2027 at close. Arrivals this window include TLS PM Gusmão, VNM PM Le Minh Hung, AUS PM Albanese. Scheduled summit, not §8 emergency.

priority_items.title: SCS CoC: Chair says ~70% of package agreed; four milestone issues open; year-end not pre-empted
priority_items.summary: FACT: DFA ASEAN spokesperson Dax Imperial (PNA 13 Nov; Philstar 12/14 Nov) said CoC negotiations are ~70% complete / 70% of the package agreed. Remaining issues include DOC relationship, legally binding character, geographic scope, and definitions (self-restraint). On 14 Nov ministerial and leaders’ agenda. Imperial will not pre-empt year-end conclusion. CNA 14 Nov analysis (Lin/Mantong) that a binding year-end text is unlikely is analysis, not a Chair claim.

priority_items.title: Myanmar/5PC: Chair holds MAH ban; Thai FM pushes AMM-level re-entry
priority_items.summary: FACT: DFA (Independent 13 Nov) — junta leaders barred; Myanmar represented by MFA ASEAN-affairs director. CLAIM (Sihasak after 12 Nov Naypyidaw visit, AFP/Manila Times 14 Nov; Reuters 13 Nov): next step should be Myanmar FM at foreign-minister level; no specific steps discussed; hoped for a decision by THA chair 2028 at the latest. Imperial: summit expected to issue a 5PC implementation review document. Not a coup; not emergency AMM.

priority_items.title: AUS–PHL defence pact expected Sunday; AFP 29 WPS hulls 3–8 Nov; no kinetic FLASH
priority_items.summary: FACT (ABC 14 Nov): AUS–PHL defence cooperation agreement expected to be signed Sunday on ASEAN sidelines (reciprocal access, intel sharing, navy/coast-guard support — ABC). Squad Combined Coordination Centre announced after Cebu 28 Oct ADMM. FACT (ABS-CBN 12 Nov): AFP 29 Chinese vessels (20 CCG + 9 PLAN) at four WPS features 3–8 Nov; no shots/injuries/second-hull in that count. Do not FLASH undated Manila Times Scarborough water-cannon chrome or 8 Oct Ayungin medevac.
